<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**Attackers raid a [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|military]] facility in the southern state of [[Bolívar (state)|Bolívar]], killing one soldier and stealing weapons. Authorities say the weapons are recovered and opposition-linked suspects are arrested.  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-military/southern-venezuela-military-facility-raided-one-soldier-dead-officials-idUSKBN1YQ0M9 (Reuters)]
*Suspected [[Boko Haram]] militants have killed at least 50 people on an island on [[Lake Chad]], bordering [[Cameroon]] and [[Chad]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50987123 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[United Kingdom|British]] retailer [[Tesco]] suspends operations at a factory in [[China]] after the ''[[Sunday Times]]'' newspaper reports that a six-year-old in [[London]] found a message from [[Shanghai]] prisoners calling for help and urging whoever finds the message to alert a [[human rights organisation]], with a link to the author of the story, hidden inside a pack of [[charity Christmas card]]s. Tesco says that it has a policy against using [[prison labour]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50883161 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019–20 Australian bushfire season]]
**[[Fire and Rescue NSW]] firefighters gain access to previously cut-off towns and settlements by [[Bushfires in Australia|bushfires]] in [[New South Wales]], taking advantage of cooler weather. The small town of [[Balmoral, New South Wales (Southern Highlands)|Balmoral]] is reported as being destroyed with NSW Premier [[Gladys Berejiklian]] saying there's "not much left" of the town. [https://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/nsw/black-christmas-record-number-of-fireys-battle-terrifying-blazes/news-story/a8c4f2e3fbc15b85b9dc98f237b3605f (''Daily Telegraph'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-bushfires/australian-firefighters-access-badly-burned-towns-pm-defends-climate-policies-idUSKBN1YP0MG (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*A [[riot]] at a [[Maximum security prison|maximum security]] [[prison]] in [[El Porvenir, Atlántida]], [[Honduras]] leaves at least 16 inmates dead, according to Honduran authorities. The riot comes just two days after another riot killed 18 inmates at a prison in the town of [[Tela]]. [https://apnews.com/796606438edfbd2d5a79a7e200aa18f1 (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Afghan presidential election]]
**[[Afghanistan]]'s incumbent [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] wins a slim majority of the votes in a September 28 election, delayed preliminary results showed after a poll that plunged the country into political crisis and was marred by allegations of fraud. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-election/afghanistans-ghani-wins-slim-majority-of-presidential-vote-in-preliminary-results-idUSKBN1YQ054 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Croatian presidential election]]
**Citizens of [[Croatia]] cast their votes in the latest [[Elections in Croatia|presidential election]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/croatians-head-to-presidential-polls-in-tight-race/a-51770348 (DW)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Over a thousand protestors march in the [[Central, Hong Kong|financial district]] of [[Hong Kong]] to show solidarity with [[Uyghurs|Uyghur]] [[Islam in China|Muslims]] in [[Xinjiang]]. A dozen [[Hong Kong Police Force|police officers]] clash with the crowd to disperse them. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/clashes-as-police-try-to-clear-hong-kong-protesters-after-uighur-support-rally-idUSKBN1YQ076 (Reuters)]
*[[2019–2020 Uzbek parliamentary election]]
**The first round of the first election in [[Uzbekistan]] after [[Islam Karimov]]'s death takes place. [https://www.rferl.org/a/uzbekistan-parliamentary-elections-mirziyoev-ldpu-tiklanish/30337815.html (Radio Free Europe)]

;Science and technology
*[[Boeing]]'s unmanned [[Boeing CST-100 Starliner|CST-100 Starliner]] crew capsule successfully reenters the atmosphere and lands at [[White Sands Missile Range]] in [[New Mexico]], [[United States]], after a failed rendezvous with the [[International Space Station]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/dec/22/nasa-boeing-starliner-capsule-lands-safely-new-mexico (''The Guardian'')]
